settings.title: Suggestions
settings.description: Optional. Add a key from one of these services and the ideas screen can suggest a few more.
settings.privacy: Your key is stored on this phone only. It never reaches our servers and your partner never sees it — if they want suggestions too, they add their own.
settings.keyInvalid: That does not look like a key for this service.
settings.keyStored: A key is saved on this phone.
settings.getKey: Where do I get a key?
settings.modelHint: Only worth changing if the default stops working.

suggest.title: Ask for a few
suggest.hintNote: What you type here is sent to the service you chose. Nothing else from the app is.
suggest.notConfigured: Add a key in Settings and a few suggestions can appear here.
suggest.disclaimer: Written by a model, not by us. Check anything before you count on it.

error.no_key: No key saved for this service yet.
error.unauthorized: That key was refused. Check it and save it again.
error.quota: That account is out of credit.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests just now. Give it a minute.
error.invalid_request: The service could not read that request.
error.model_unavailable: That model is not available. Try clearing the model field.
error.provider_down: The service is having trouble. Try again shortly.
error.network: Could not reach the service. Check your connection.
error.timeout: That took too long. Try again.
error.refused: The model declined to answer that one.
error.malformed: The reply could not be read.
error.empty: Nothing usable came back. Try again.
